summary: Iteration 18 — validated three new features end-to-end: (1) Accent Colour backend (PUT/GET /api/reports/branding with normalization, invalid-ignore, clear); (2) Preview In Modal (New Board Report modal shows modal-cover-preview + dark/light theme toggle producing valid PNG images); (3) Hint Analytics (POST /api/advisor/hint-open records + GET /api/advisor/usage returns hint_opens/hint_unique, frontend fires POST from advisor-hint bubble + advisor-hint-stat renders in admin panel). Backend: 8/8 pytest passing. Frontend: all data-testid selectors match implementation; accent colour persists across reload, clear resets to default, live preview thumbnail (branding-preview-img) refreshes (naturalWidth=857). Modal cover preview loaded in ~12s after New Board Report click; theme-dark/theme-light toggles swap ?theme= param and PNG re-loads with valid naturalWidth. Advisor hint stat rendered 'intro-hint opens: 3 · 1 exec'. Accent reset to empty in cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings.jsx line 204: brand.accent color input controlled correctly (value + onChange). Note: automated tests must use native HTMLInputElement value setter (React tracked values) instead of el.value=... to trigger onChange properly.
reports.py _norm_hex correctly normalizes/validates hex; invalid values (e.g. 'red') return empty and PUT stores '' — good defensive validation.
ai_advisor.py hint-open handler uses any authenticated user (correct); usage returns hint_opens/hint_unique aggregated per org.
BoardReportModal keys the preview on theme so React fully re-mounts on toggle (avoids stale image cache) — clean pattern.
